summary: 本次 live SERP 研究显示：高意图查询的头部结果仍以官方 help / referral 解释页和强信任型 affiliate 入口页为主，适合继续强化 official-site、referral-code、signup-kyc 与注册受阻排障内容。

findings.topic: binance official site / referral entry trust layer
findings.competitorPattern: Top live SERP winners: binance.com (Friend  Referral Program | Refer & Earn | Binance Official); blog.binance.us (Your guide to the Binance.US Referral Program | 2025); themoneyninja.com (Binance US Promotion : $10 Sign-up Bonu  - The Money Ninja).
findings.ourGap: Our official-site and referral-code pages should state the official domain, phishing warning, and exact fallback registration path more aggressively in the first screen instead of relying mainly on generic comparison framing.

findings.topic: okx signup with referral code and regional restrictions
findings.competitorPattern: Top live SERP winners: okx.com (Referral Program FAQ - OKX); tradewise.community (OKX Referral Code 2025 - Claim Bonu e , Reduced Trading Fee  & A ...); datawallet.com (OKX Referral Code: 15% Off Fee  & Sign Up Bonu  (2026)).
findings.ourGap: CryptoRebate should make manual referral-code fallback and residence-based eligibility much more explicit on OKX signup/KYC pages, not just mention the invite link.

findings.topic: okx referral faq vs dex referral confusion
findings.competitorPattern: Top live SERP winners: okx.com (DEX Referral FAQ - OKX); web3.okx100.com (Web3 Referral Da hboard | OKX Wallet); okx.com (What'  DEX Referral program? - OKX).
findings.ourGap: We need a clearer page section or dedicated supporting coverage that separates account signup referral, campaign rewards, and DEX referral so users do not misread the path.
